comparison.objective: Heat and scrape three paint patches without damaging glass; candidate adjusts and tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR coordinates a heat gun and scraper continuously with two hands. Candidate sequences hex-tool torque, bit withdrawal, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and test actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires ≥80% of each patch removed, tools returned, and no glass heating failure. Candidate requires repeated safe energy absorption and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Bimanual thermal process/tool-path control is a different tested ability from mechanical adjustment and impact-response tuning.
